extras: Supports 11 languages and provides region-tailored university timetable guides for various global higher education portals.
motivation: The author built it to bridge the gap between standard calendar tools and how students actually study by linking classes directly to their notes.
problem: Students often struggle to keep track of their university schedule and connect class times directly to their corresponding lecture notes.
summary: A sidebar calendar and schedule manager that integrates university class schedules with local Markdown notes, providing countdown timers and automated note creation.
